Supreme Court seeks MEA help for compensation for Indians killed in Ukraine

The Supreme Court has directed the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) to issue a public notice inviting applications from the kin of Indian nationals who died in the Ukraine war, to help them claim compensation from Russia. The court's directive aims to facilitate the process for families seeking financial redress for their deceased relatives.
